description: Implement Task 4 (Webhook Alerts & DustMonitor Upgrades) and Task 5 (Visual Monitoring Dashboard). These are monitoring/observability features.
steps: Create pkgs/cli/src/monitor/webhooks.ts with an async function sendWebhookAlert(payload: WebhookPayload) that posts to SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL and DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env vars (if set). Use axios for HTTP posts. Before sending, redact any values matching seed/mnemonic/private key patterns (reuse the SENSITIVE_PATTERN regex from logger.ts). Format Slack payload as {text: message} and Discord as {content: message}.

Extend pkgs/cli/src/monitor/dust.ts DustMonitor class: add a private requestCounter (tracks requests in the last 5 minutes using a sliding window array of timestamps). Add method recordRequest() that appends to the window. In the interval subscription, after checking isLowDust, also check if requestCounter exceeds 30 in the last 5 minutes. When either threshold is breached, call sendWebhookAlert with appropriate message. Import and use the webhook module.
Add SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL and DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL to .env.example with empty placeholder values.

Create pkgs/cli/public/dashboard.html - a single-page responsive dashboard using Tailwind CSS (CDN) and Chart.js (CDN). Must poll GET /health every 10 seconds. Display: current DUST balance vs capacity cap (5 DUST per NIGHT), active queue status (pending count, lock status), metrics of total sponsored transactions and failed attempts (read from /health response). Use Chart.js line chart for balance history over time.

Update pkgs/cli/src/relayer/server.ts to serve static files from a 'public' directory using express.static(). Add the static middleware before routes. The path should resolve to pkgs/cli/public/ relative to the source.

Extend the /health endpoint response in server.ts to include totalSponsored and totalFailed counters. Add a simple in-memory counter object that the sponsor route increments on success/failure. Pass it to the app factory or use a shared module.
acceptance_criteria: DustMonitor triggers webhook alerts on low DUST (< 5e14 specks) and request spike (> 30 in 5 min)
Sensitive data is redacted before webhook dispatch
pkgs/cli/public/dashboard.html exists and is a valid HTML5 page with Tailwind + Chart.js
Dashboard polls /health and displays DUST balance, queue status, and tx metrics
/health includes totalSponsored and totalFailed in response
findings: Moved RelayerMetrics interface to a separate metrics.ts file to avoid circular dependency between server.ts and routes/sponsor.ts. The .gitignore had a 'public' entry (Gatsby leftover) that required force-adding the dashboard file. All tests pass. The dashboard.html uses CDN links for Tailwind and Chart.js.
